blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The National Police Commission (Napolcom) is probing two Laoag City cops who were caught allegedly counterflowing at a roundabout on Sept. 19. In a statement on Friday (Sept. 25), the Napolcom office in the Ilocos region said the two officers have been identified and were issued traffic citation tickets. This comes after the incident was captured on video and circulated on social media. The two cops were also relieved from the Laoag City Police Station pending administrative proceedings.
